international.title: Tusk appears to mock Trump’s Putin comment as Ukraine’s allies meet in Berlin – Europe live
international.summary: After US president called Putin a friend, Poland’s PM said: ‘God, protect us from such friends’ For what it’s worth, the China-US-Russia ‘peace declaration’ issued after their meeting, and published by Chinese state media , includes absolutely no mention of Ukraine or Europe whatsoever. There is only one, rather generic, line that could be seen as close to these issues: “The three heads of state exchanged in-depth views on the current international situation and pledged to maintain strategic stability and international security.” Continue reading...
